# muslimdata.in

> Indicators of living conditions for India's Muslim population, with Hindu and all-India comparison baselines on every metric. Covers population, education, employment, health, representation, and justice. Provenance-traced, Sachar-Committee-style measurement.

muslimdata.in is a static, source-traceable dashboard of living-conditions indicators for India's Muslim population, with Hindu and all-India comparison baselines on every metric. It is modelled on the Hawaii state dashboard pattern. Every value traces to a primary government source (Census of India, NFHS, PLFS, NCRB, AISHE, Sachar Committee) with the original file archived and checksummed.

## Reading the data
- Each metric has a page at /m/{id}/ and a machine-readable CSV at /canonical/{id}.csv (CORS-enabled). CSV columns: metric_id, geography_level, geography_code, year, religion, value, denominator, source_id, source_document, methodology_note.
- Comparisons are Muslim vs Hindu vs all-India; each metric shows the year its data is current to.
- The 2021 Census is delayed, so demographic metrics are 2011 or earlier.

## Metrics
- Muslim share of population (1961-2011; source: census-india-2011): https://muslimdata.in/m/pop-share/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/pop-share.csv
- Urban share (2001-2011; source: census-india-2011): https://muslimdata.in/m/urban-share/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/urban-share.csv
- Sex ratio (1961-2011; source: census-india-2011): https://muslimdata.in/m/sex-ratio/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/sex-ratio.csv
- Literacy rate (2001-2011; source: census-india-2011): https://muslimdata.in/m/lit-7plus/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/lit-7plus.csv
- Higher education enrolment rate (2020-2021; source: aishe): https://muslimdata.in/m/ger-higher-ed/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/ger-higher-ed.csv
- Labour force participation (2017-2023; source: plfs): https://muslimdata.in/m/lfpr-15plus/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/lfpr-15plus.csv
- Unemployment rate (2017-2023; source: plfs-microdata): https://muslimdata.in/m/unemployment-rate-15plus/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/unemployment-rate-15plus.csv
- Workers in salaried jobs (2017-2023; source: plfs): https://muslimdata.in/m/salaried-share/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/salaried-share.csv
- Monthly spending per person (2004-2023; source: hces-2023-24): https://muslimdata.in/m/mpce/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/mpce.csv
- Household net worth (2012; source: aidis-2013): https://muslimdata.in/m/household-net-worth/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/household-net-worth.csv
- Infant mortality rate (1998-2020; source: nfhs-5): https://muslimdata.in/m/imr/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/imr.csv
- Child stunting (under 5) (2020; source: nfhs-5): https://muslimdata.in/m/stunting-u5/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/stunting-u5.csv
- Institutional delivery rate (1998-2020; source: nfhs-5): https://muslimdata.in/m/inst-delivery/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/inst-delivery.csv
- Anaemia in women (1998-2020; source: nfhs-5): https://muslimdata.in/m/women-anemia/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/women-anemia.csv
- Toilet access (2020; source: nfhs-5): https://muslimdata.in/m/improved-sanitation/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/improved-sanitation.csv
- Improved drinking water within premises (2018; source: nss76-housing): https://muslimdata.in/m/improved-water-premises/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/improved-water-premises.csv
- Pucca housing (2018; source: nss76-housing): https://muslimdata.in/m/pucca-house/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/pucca-house.csv
- Muslim share of the Lok Sabha (1952-2024; source: prs-eci-affidavits): https://muslimdata.in/m/ls-share/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/ls-share.csv
- Incarceration rate (2022; source: ncrb-prison): https://muslimdata.in/m/prison-rate-per-100k/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/prison-rate-per-100k.csv
- Communal incidents recorded by police (2015-2023; source: ncrb-crime): https://muslimdata.in/m/communal-incidents-govt/ | data: https://muslimdata.in/canonical/communal-incidents-govt.csv
